name: MPRIS player fixes
description: Browser-player fixes for the compact, full and lock players: seek bars no longer pin at the end when a player (Firefox, Zen, YouTube tabs) reports no track length; Zen gets its own player icon (it shares Firefox's MPRIS bus name); and cover art falls back to the YouTube thumbnail from xesam:url when mpris:artUrl is empty. Ships a companion userscript that keeps Firefox and Zen publishing position and length on every site. A Patch browser button on the mod's row in Settings > Mods walks you through installing Violentmonkey and the userscript in your browser and shows Patched once both are in place.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Loads cover-art thumbnails from i.ytimg.com when a player provides no artwork
Reads your Firefox-family browser profiles (extensions.json, prefs.js and a copy of Violentmonkey's storage) to tell whether Violentmonkey and the userscript are installed
Opens the Violentmonkey add-on page and the userscript's install URL in your browser when you press Patch browser; nothing is written into the browser profile
